game_title: Call Stack Tower – Furrier Lane Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Call Stack Tower: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Trace nested function calls as stacked blocks and unwind them in order. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_height value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the ice mill using at most 20 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The ice mill reached with actions_used <= 20.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 20 before the ice mill is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Call Stack Tower
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
